title: Mem2A update
description: Tells the agent that its dossier changed while the task was open. Sent by memory as a data part (mediaType `application/vnd.mem2a.update+json`) in a status message with phase `awaiting-commit`, right after the replaced `dossier` artifact.

summary.description: What changed, in one plain sentence, for example `Legal cleared Acme pricing.`

change.description: `removed` covers retirement and loss of access alike, so that the update does not reveal which.
